nodes.description: Address payable receiving the marketplace commission; set in constructor and mutable via updateAdmin.
Owner of the marketplace, used as the sole authorization check in updateAdmin.
Commission rate 0-100 used to split sale/auction proceeds between admin and seller.
Mapping tokenId => fixed sell price (and last bid marker); drives buy and sell logic and is zeroed after a sale.
Mapping tokenId => Auction struct holding beneficiary, end time, highest bidder, highest bid, open flag and reserve.
Mapping tokenId => payment address receiving proceeds of a fixed-price sale.
Mapping tokenId => last price sold or auctioned.
Payable nonReentrant purchase function; transfers NFT via callOptionalReturn and pays seller/admin with low-level calls.
Payable nonReentrant auction bid; refunds previous highest bidder with a low-level call before storing the new bid.
NonReentrant refund of the highest bid when the auction cannot be finalized, then deletes the auction.
NonReentrant auction settlement; pays beneficiary and admin via low-level calls and transfers the NFT.
Lists a token for fixed-price sale, self-approving the marketplace and setting the payout wallet.
Creates an auction for a token owned by the caller and self-approves the marketplace.
Administrative setter for admin, commissionRate and anyoneCanMint, gated by msg.sender == contract_owner.
Private helper performing a raw low-level call to the token contract and optional return-data decoding.
ERC721 transfer entry point invoked by the marketplace through callOptionalReturn to move the NFT.
ERC721 approval function used by sell/createAuction to grant the marketplace transfer rights.
Attacker-controlled caller used for ownership checks, bidding identity and the updateAdmin authorization check.
Block timestamp (now) used to gate bid, canWithdraw, canFinalize and auctionFinalize timing.
Origin address of the transaction; no explicit use in this contract, tracked as a potential authorization input.
Low-level .call.value(...)() Ether transfers to _wallets, admin, highestBidder and beneficiary in buy/bid/withdraw/auctionFinalize.
tokenId argument of buy() used to index sellBidPrice, auctions and the token owner lookup.
Computed commission amount in buy(): msg.value * commissionRate / 100.
Computed seller proceeds in buy(): msg.value - amount4admin.
tokenId argument of bid() indexing the auctions mapping and owner lookup.
price argument of sell() written into sellBidPrice and used to decide whether the item is for sale.
tokenId argument of auctionFinalize() used to read settlement data and clear the auction.
owner = ownerOf(tokenId) cached inside buy() and passed to transferFrom.

edges.reason: sell() authorizes the caller with ownerOf(tokenId)==msg.sender, so msg.sender controls listing rights.
buy() uses msg.sender for the self-purchase and recipient checks, driving who receives the NFT.
bid() writes msg.sender into auctions[tokenId].highestBidder and refunds that address later.
updateAdmin authorizes with msg.sender==contract_owner; control of this input grants admin mutation.
bid() depends on block.timestamp (now <= auctionEnd) to accept bids, creating a timestamp dependency.
withdraw() depends on block.timestamp via canWithdraw for the auction-end condition.
auctionFinalize requires block.timestamp >= auctionEnd, gating settlement timing.
buy() sends Ether with a low-level call to _wallets and admin before clearing sellBidPrice and _wallets, enabling reentrancy on state that is still set.
bid() refunds the previous highest bidder with a low-level call before updating highestBidder/highestBid, allowing reentrant refunds.
withdraw() performs a low-level Ether transfer to the bidder before deleting the auction state.
auctionFinalize pays beneficiary and admin with low-level calls before deleting auctions[tokenId] and finalizing ownership.
callOptionalReturn performs the raw address(token).call(data) that reaches the unsafe low-level call sink.
buy() invokes callOptionalReturn(this, transferFrom selector) to move the NFT from the seller.
auctionFinalize invokes callOptionalReturn to transfer the NFT to the highest bidder.
The encoded call from callOptionalReturn dispatches into transferFrom on this contract as an external self-call.
buy() computes the commission as msg.value.mul(commissionRate).div(100), making the rate feed an arithmetic split.
auctionFinalize computes commission from commissionRate and highestBid using mul/div.
buy() reads sellBidPrice[tokenId] to validate the sale and require sufficient msg.value.
bid() reads and writes auctions[tokenId] fields (highestBid, highestBidder, open).
auctionFinalize reads auction beneficiary, highestBid, reserve and clears the struct.
buy() pays the sale proceeds to the low-level call target _wallets[tokenId].
updateAdmin reassigns the admin address, controlling where future commissions are sent.
updateAdmin compares msg.sender against contract_owner; this state var is the authorization source.
sell() calls approve(address(this), tokenId) to grant the marketplace transfer rights.
createAuction() calls approve(address(this), tokenId) so the marketplace can move the NFT on settlement.
The buy() tokenId parameter indexes sellBidPrice and auctions and is passed to ownerOf.
amount4admin feeds the low-level Ether transfer to admin inside buy().
amount4owner feeds the low-level Ether transfer to _wallets[tokenId] inside buy().
The cached owner local is passed into the encoded transferFrom call in buy().
The bid() tokenId parameter selects the auction being bid on and is emitted in HighestBidIncreased.
The sell() price parameter is stored in sellBidPrice and determines whether the approve/wallet branch executes.
The auctionFinalize tokenId parameter selects the auction to settle and clears it after payment.

normalization_plan.reason: param_buy_tokenId is only used to index the marketplace mappings inside buy(), so it folds into the buy() function node.
local_amount4admin is a temporary commission value computed and immediately spent by buy(); it collapses into buy().
local_amount4owner is a temporary payout value created and spent within buy(); it collapses into buy().
local_buy_owner exists only to feed the encoded transferFrom call in buy(), so it merges into buy().
param_bid_tokenId is consumed solely by bid() for auction selection, so it merges into bid().
param_sell_price is written into sellBidPrice and only used by sell(), so it merges into sell().
param_finalize_tokenId is only used to read and delete the auction in auctionFinalize, so it merges into that function.
